title: 游戏世界缺乏生机与多样性
description: 游戏世界和空间站内容空洞、重复，缺乏有意义的互动和事件，地点设计缺乏独特性，NPC行为异常，导致世界显得死气沉沉、不真实。
evidence: the more 'modest' locations you find are supposedly inhabited by hundreds of people but they look like they could maybe support five
The solar system and universe feels dead, as in, there are no meaningful interactions
the world itself feels very dead. Locations which are implied to be massive end up being a small and barren collection of boxes and corridors

evidence_items.quote: The world (stations, ships, npcs) does not really feel alive. The npcs and their mission feel arbitrarily randomised and the stations I visited were somewhat of a let down.
evidence_items.description: 世界（空间站、飞船、NPC）感觉不真实，NPC和任务随机化，空间站令人失望。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这个世界（空间站、飞船、NPC）并不真的让人觉得有生气。NPC和他们的任务感觉是随意随机化的，而我访问过的空间站也有些令人失望。

evidence_items.quote: So many of the stations in the game have cookie-cutter layouts
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里那么多空间站都是千篇一律的布局

evidence_items.quote: NPCs routinely suffocate to death in their space suits inside the station because they're THAT stupid, and nobody cares
evidence_items.description: NPC在空间站内穿着宇航服窒息而死，无人理会
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC经常在空间站里穿着宇航服窒息而死，因为他们就是那么蠢，而且没人在乎

evidence_items.quote: it's all taking place in a DEAD world where nothing matters and everything is faked
evidence_items.description: 游戏世界空洞，一切都没有意义且是虚假的
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这一切都发生在一个死寂的世界里，那里什么都不重要，一切都是假的

evidence_items.quote: The solar system and universe feels dead, as in, there are no meaningful interactions
evidence_items.description: 宇宙缺乏有意义的互动和事件
evidence_items.quote_zh: 太阳系和宇宙感觉死气沉沉，也就是说，没有任何有意义的互动

evidence_items.quote: the more 'modest' locations you find are supposedly inhabited by hundreds of people but they look like they could maybe support five
evidence_items.description: 游戏地图规模与设定不符
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即便是你找到的那些更“不起眼”的地点，据说也住着数百人，但它们看起来最多也就只能容纳五个人

evidence_items.quote: There are far too few different ship parts and ship hulls in the game.
evidence_items.description: 游戏中不同飞船部件和船体种类太少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里不同飞船部件和船体的种类实在太少了。

evidence_items.quote: There are like, three locations in the game that you can travel to that are unique, the rest of the stations are copy pastes.
evidence_items.description: 游戏里只有三个独特地点，其余空间站都是复制粘贴的。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里大概只有三个可以前往的独特地点，其余的太空站都是复制粘贴的。

evidence_items.quote: the world itself feels very dead. Locations which are implied to be massive end up being a small and barren collection of boxes and corridors
evidence_items.description: 世界显得死气沉沉，地点实际很小且空旷
evidence_items.quote_zh: 世界本身感觉非常死寂。那些暗示规模庞大的地点最终只是由箱子和走廊组成的一小片荒芜之地

evidence_items.quote: В игре абсолютно нет разнообразия в деталях корабля: один вид пола, один вид стен, один вид батарей, один вид реактора, по одному виду датчиков давления и температуры, один вид для ВСЕХ объектов.
evidence_items.description: 飞船部件完全没有多样性，地板、墙壁、电池、反应堆、传感器等所有对象都只有一种外观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏中的飞船部件完全没有多样性：一种地板，一种墙壁，一种电池，一种反应堆，压力和温度传感器各一种，所有物体都只有一种外观。
